magic_moment.description: The moment the product proves its promise. Called the hero moment in earlier revisions and in the Hackathon done bar.

onboarding.description: The shortest route from cold start to the magic moment, one entry per step.

landing.description: Positioning copy for the landing page or store listing.

description: Nothing loads this at runtime; it documents the shape templates/design-contract.md fills. `onboarding`, `landing`, and `design_system` are not in `required` because Prototype and Hackathon cut them by default (references/design-loop.md); every durable mode's done bar still asks for all three.
